q: As a man thinketh in his heart, so shall he be.
Boldness makes even the smallest animal dangerous.
Invisible things are the only realities.
Excellence is not a skill. It is an attitude.
Obstacles don't block the path, they are the path.
It's only after you've stepped outside your comfort zone that you begin to change, grow, and transform.
Change will not come if we wait for some other person, or if we wait for some other time.
Take into account that great love and great achievements involve great risk.
There is nothing more truly artistic than to love people.
Meanings are not determined by situations, but we determine ourselves by the meanings we give to situations.
Make each day your masterpiece.
A mentor is someone who sees more talent and ability within you, than you see in yourself, and helps bring it out of you.
It is our choices that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities.
Only in the agony of parting do we look into the depths of love.
Any game becomes important when you know and love the players.
An intelligent person hires people who are more intelligent than he is.
In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
Trying to define yourself is like trying to bite your own teeth.
We tend to live up to our expectations.
Your hardest times often lead to the greatest moments of your life. Keep going. Tough situations build strong people in the end.
A successful man is one who can lay a firm foundation with the bricks others have thrown at him.
Everyone you meet is fighting a battle you know nothing about. Be kind. Always.
Be the silent watcher of your thoughts and behavior. You are beneath the thinker.
Do not save what is left after spending, but spend what is left after saving.
The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.
You are the average of the five people you spend most time with.
The shoe that fits one person pinches another; there is no recipe for living that suits all cases.
Hope is a waking dream.
People think about what they don't want and attract more of the same.
He who is not contented with what he has, would not be contented with what he would like to have.
Embrace the life you have and stop wishing that you could be someone else.
Shoot for the moon. Even if you miss, you'll land among the stars.
Unless someone truly has the power to say no, they never truly have the power to say yes.
There are dark shadows on the earth, but its lights are stronger in the contrast.
Happiness must be grown in one's own garden.
Ripe fruit falls by itself - but it doesn't fall in your mouth.
Life is ten percent what you experience and ninety percent how you respond to it.
The more you are focused on time - past and future - the more you miss the Now, the most precious thing there is.
Live in the sunshine, swim the sea, drink the wild air.
Why compare yourself with others? No one in the entire world can do a better job of being you than you.
It is better to fail in originality than to succeed in imitation.
A man sees in the world what he carries in his heart.
Be - don't try to become
True life is lived when tiny changes occur.
Nothing is hopeless; we must hope for everything.
There are two kinds of perfect people: those who are dead, and those who have not been born yet.
Silence is sometimes the best answer.
Those who are enlightened never stop forging themselves.
Thinking is the hardest work there is, which is probably the reason why so few engage in it.
Integrity is the ability to stand by an idea.
